checked.how: reset() sets firstLap=true; sync() clears it once racers[0].lapsCompleted>=1 and never sets it back. src/sim/race.ts: the first line crossing only sets started, so lapsCompleted hits 1 at the 2nd crossing (start of lap 2), matching AC5. game.startRace() calls reset() then draw()->sync() in one task, so no stale legend is painted.

update(): hidden = !(desktop && firstLap). watchDesktop() calls back once at creation, so the initial state matches the hidden markup. setFirstLap() early-returns when unchanged, so steady frames write no DOM (race-ui 'touches no DOM' test still holds). A resize only flips 'desktop' and re-evaluates.

ceil(844*1.45)=1224 and ceil(390*1.45)=566, as the spec says. Query '(pointer: fine) and (min-width: 1224px) and (min-height: 566px)' is inclusive at the threshold. COARSE_POINTER is the same string touch-controls used before. layout.ts imports only @tokens, so no cycle.

Grepped call sites of createRaceUi/createHud/createKeycapLegend: game.ts builds one RaceUi per page and the stage harness one per page. RaceUi and Hud have no destroy() and nothing is recreated, so nothing leaks at runtime. Not reported.

checked.target: State across restart, pause, quit-to-menu, retry (game.ts)
checked.how: showMenu() hides the whole race layer; startRace() always resets then syncs. The legend precedes results and pause in DOM order, so their overlays paint above it. Pausing in lap 1 and resuming keeps the legend, as intended.

checked.target: Input pass-through: .ui-keys and the touch layer
checked.how: keycap-legend.css sets pointer-events:none on .ui-keys; the panel inherits it. Touch hit-testing is window-level via touch.zones() slot rects, so the legend cannot swallow touches or clicks. Legend text matches src/input/keyboard.ts (arrows, WASD, Escape=PAUSE_KEY).

After the first touch the touch layer is revealed and the legend visually overlaps the steer pads; input still works. Plan audit minor #4 explicitly accepted this ('Don't invent extra rules'), so it is not reported.

checked.target: CSS custom properties used by the new rules
checked.how: Every var() in hud.css, keycap-legend.css and components.css exists in guardrails/generated/tokens.css (--desktop-margin/-outline/-scale, --type-*-size-desktop incl. button, --space-s1..s7, --shadow-hud/-button, --duration-slide, --ease-snap, --touch-min-target). No typos, so no silently invalid declarations.

Overrides have specificity (0,3,0)+ against (0,1,0) base rules. BEST chip border-top:0 is re-asserted after the border-width override. Minimap box 150.8x104.4 with the SVG viewBox kept. At 1224x566 the legend (about 584x76, bottom-left) cannot overlap the top-left stack (ends near y=244) or the countdown.

Equal specificity, so the later file wins. keycap-legend.ts imports components.css first and race-ui loads countdown.ts (components.css) before keycap-legend.css, so order holds in dev, stage build and production. Screenshots show 16px labels and 4px outlines.

Animates transform only, with a reduced-motion cut; passes the static rules in tests/ui/source-rules.test.ts (keyframe properties, no raw px/ms). It replays on each un-hide (race start or breakpoint crossing), which is acceptable.
Traced each vertex list: valid single-polygon arrows with symmetric heads (4..20) and stems (9..15), mirrored correctly. Matches the 1440x900 screenshot.
The diff touches nothing under src/sim or src/driver. Grepped src/ui for Math.random/Date.now/innerWidth: nothing new. gates.md: G2 bot laps +0.0%, G3 replays identical to main.

racer(3,3,[]) gives lapsCompleted 0 and lap 1; the name is kebab-case and registered by glob; screenshots/index.json lists hud--first-lap at both viewports. The 844x390 shot shows touch controls and no legend; the 1440x900 shot shows the legend.

checked.target: Screenshots at 1440x900 and 844x390 (stages and race frames)
checked.how: Viewed hud--first-lap, hud--mid-race, pause--paused, bends-start/mid-race/countdown, dust-bowl-mid-race/finished. Legend shows in lap 1 (countdown, GO, mid lap 1), is absent in lap 2/2 and the pause stage, never appears at 844x390. Desktop sizes and 32px margins look right.

Checked the regex on the compound query and the EventTarget-based list (addEventListener exists). helpers.ts afterEach calls unstubAllGlobals, so the stub cannot leak. AC6 asserts the legend exists but is hidden in touch and small contexts after showing on desktop, so it is not vacuous.

Same build/serve/launch pattern as tests/ui/results-fit-phone.test.ts. Exact equality (left=32; 1440-pause.right=32) is safe since the right edge is anchored at 1408 on 1/64px LayoutUnits. Contexts left open on failure are closed by browser.close() in afterAll. AC2 uses expect.poll across setViewportSize.

Read node_modules/happy-dom MediaQueryItem: (pointer: fine) is true when maxTouchPoints===0; min-width uses innerWidth (default 1024, so desktop=false). Existing hud/race-ui/pause tests take the phone path without stubs, and MediaQueryList has addEventListener. Consistent with 611/611.
vite.config.ts build.target is es2023, so Safari/iOS 13 (addListener only) is not a supported target. No finding.

checked.target: Edge cases: zero/one/many cars, 1-lap tracks, finish, ties
checked.how: racers[0] missing would leave firstLap true, but raceView always has >=1 racer and startRace rejects bad counts. On a 1-lap track the legend hides at finish (lapsCompleted=1), before results show. The legend has no counts, so no '1 LAPS' style label issue.
